lines.en: I push up out of the water
Wet prints trail behind me
I drag myself along the shore
Water runs off me without end

lines.zh: 我的影子在水面上裂开
lines.en: My shadow splits on the water
I step through the shallows
Something follows me underwater
The water darkens where I pass
I move slower than the current

lines.zh: 我的轮廓一直没定下来
lines.en: My outline never settles
I creep along the waterline
I hold along the waterline
The water circles my feet
Droplets hang on me and do not fall
I listen to the sound below

lines.zh: 水从我的下巴滴回河里
lines.en: Water drips from my chin back into the river
My shape is not quite right

lines.zh: 我在看水里自己的影子
lines.en: I watch my reflection in the water
My breathing sounds like water

lines.zh: 我一动不动地看着水面
lines.en: I watch the surface without moving
The surface never settles
I lift one hand from the water
I do not mean to come ashore
Drops fall from my fingertips

lines.zh: 水下的泥在我脚边翻起
lines.en: Mud turns up by my feet
I look up at you from under the water

lines.zh: 你站在离水太近的地方
lines.en: You stand too close to the water
My face floats under the surface
Did you hear that water sound
I turn to face you square
My outline wavers in your sight

lines.zh: 你身后是更深的那一段
lines.en: The deeper stretch lies behind you

lines.zh: 我停在你正前方的水里
lines.en: I stop in the water right before you
My eyes are blacker than the water
One step back and the water stirs

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，水跟着起来
lines.en: I lift a hand and the water follows

lines.zh: 你的影子落到我身上了
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，水就从颈边流
lines.en: I tilt my head and water runs off

lines.zh: 你不知道我在哪一层水里
lines.en: You do not know which layer holds me

lines.zh: 我脸上没有表情可以看
lines.en: There is no expression to read

lines.zh: 我把手放在岸边的泥上
lines.en: I lay a hand on the muddy bank
When I speak it is only water

lines.zh: 你脚边的水正在往上涨
lines.en: The water at your feet is rising
Only my head shows above the water
A piece of me scatters and returns
I step back into the water
Water splashes out in a ring
My shape blurs for a moment
I look down at the wound
Even the water stays quiet
Drops fall off me
I can still stand in the water
I heal faster in the water
Do not think I will come apart
You toss it into the shallows
And down it goes
I watch it fall
I do not want this kind of thing

lines.zh: 水里的东西我自己会拿
lines.en: I take what I want from the water
Just stay on the bank
I reach and pull my hand back

lines.zh: 这东西在水里没有味道
lines.en: This has no taste in water

lines.zh: 我伸手一按，泥把它吞了
lines.en: I press once, and the mud swallows it
I am waiting for something else
You hit me like hitting water
I scatter and gather again
My body has no hardness
My body slips like water.
The water rings outward
I re-form in front of you
That only left me wetter

lines.zh: 我的头在水里晃了一下
lines.en: My head rocks once in the water
The surface settles once you step back
There are others under the water
Something answers from below

lines.zh: 我们各自待在各自的水里
lines.en: Each of us keeps to our own water
That is not our concern
I look down at the surface

lines.zh: 我的影子在水里分开了
lines.en: My reflection separates in the water
The surface closes, leaving only a ring of bubbles
We know each other by the sound of water
There are no names in the water
I fish it up out of the water
It is still dripping
I hold it up between my fingers
This has gone soft in the water
I throw it back in
It sinks out of sight
And I look at the water again
I press it into the silt
It slips the moment I loosen
Your feet are already wet
My head comes up out of the water
The surface dips toward me
I have moved your way

lines.zh: 我的影子先伸到你脚下
lines.en: My shadow reaches your feet first
I am not fast, but water is

lines.zh: 你听到我踩水的声音了
lines.en: You hear me wading

lines.zh: 我选好了一条靠近的路
lines.en: I have picked my approach
You should not stand this near the edge
I begin to climb out
The surface turns over once
You have stepped into the shallows
I brace a hand on the bank

lines.zh: 水正顺着坡往你那边去
lines.en: The water is running your way
I rise from the bottom
Looking back will not help
I have not left the water
You retreat slowly on the bank
The water rises to your feet
I work my way through the water
You will regret not watching the water

lines.zh: 岸线在我脚下一点点吃进
lines.en: The shoreline eats inward beneath my feet
My shadow travels along the bank
The mud under you is loosening
The surface follows me
Do you hear the water growing louder
I work a little further ashore

lines.zh: 你的每条退路都在水边
lines.en: Every way back runs by the water
I wait for you to step into the shallows

lines.zh: 潮水从我的肩头往下淌
lines.en: Water runs off my shoulders
Something is behind you in the water
I stretch a hand onto the bank
Your knee is a hand from the water
I am going to start dragging

lines.zh: 水底的声音跟我一起上来了
lines.en: The sounds below come up with me
I seize your ankle
I haul you into the deep
A wet hand slaps your face
I bear down with all of me
You choke on a mouthful of water
My strength comes like a tide
The mud gives under you
I push at you again and again
Water covers your knees
I sweep a whole arm at you
You are hauled off balance
I force your hand down
The water reaches your waist
I drag you half a step
You choke on water again
The surface bulges first
I rise up out of the water
Droplets lift into the air

lines.zh: 浅滩上多了一个湿影子
lines.en: A wet shape joins the shallows
The sound of water swells
I stand knee-deep

lines.zh: 我的轮廓从水里挣出来
lines.en: My outline pulls free of the water
The bank begins to slump
I bring my head above the surface
There is no reflection of me

lines.zh: 我从水底一直升到这里
lines.en: I have risen all the way from the bottom
The water at my feet turns black
One hand comes out first
Muddy water runs off my shoulders
I find footing on the sunken stones
That stretch of bank has emptied
I grow up out of the surface
The far side of the pool stirs too
The water on me pulls downward
The water goes silent for a beat

lines.zh: 火燎过来，我冒起一片水汽
lines.en: Fire passes and I steam all over
I splash apart on landing

lines.zh: 水是我的，我却喘不上气
lines.en: Water is mine, and I cannot breathe it
The blast scatters me and I gather
An arrow passes through me

lines.zh: 咒光让我的轮廓抖起来
lines.en: Magic makes my outline shudder
Away too long, I begin to dry
Lightning crawls over me with the water
I fall where there is not even water
